== Notes ==
{{anomaly|Unlike regular degeneration hexes, Vile Miasma causes a health bar to turn green such as poison or disease, or pink if used from bleeding.}}
* Using this skill after [[Signet of Suffering]] or [[Glyph of Immolation]] will apply this hex.

== Trivia ==
* In the Middle Ages there was a theory that disease was spread through the air, in a poisonous, foul smelling vapor, known as [[w:Miasma_theory_of_disease|miasma]].
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
